description: A sealed research job: named shards (arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Europe PMC, Wikipedia, standards and docs) collected, grafted, reviewed and woven into a signed page every later agent reuses. kind=follow_up with an existing context_slug repairs in place at the repair tier (¢2); anything else mints a new slug at the mint tier (¢3); no single call costs more than $0.05. An unpaid call returns status=payment_required. The result carries job_id, poll and wiki URLs; the seal takes minutes.

bounty_id.description: On-chain bounty this work delivers against (see /api/v1/bounties)

context_slug.description: Existing non-stub slug to densify (repair tier). Unknown or stub slugs are charged as mint.

kind.description: workflow is a Full alias (reusable task pack). follow_up + context_slug repairs an existing page at the repair tier.

pow_challenge.description: The challenge from a payment_required result

pow_nonce.description: Nonce such that SHA-256(challenge || ':' || nonce) has difficulty_bits leading zero bits

query.description: Task or topic; 'Phrase (ACRO)' teaches the catalog an acronym

work_token.description: Work-rail token (deai_wk_…) earned with the work tool; spends credit on this node. Same as sending Authorization: Bearer.

x_payment.description: x402 v1 PaymentPayload, base64 JSON, for one of `accepts` (when the USDC rail is open)

name: research
title: Repair (¢2) or mint (¢3) a sealed page
